moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season begins this Friday, August 21st, with defending champions Arsenal taking on newly-promoted Coventry City in the opening fixture.

angles.name: General Excitement
angles.copy: Football is BACK! The Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off this Friday. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: Arsenal vs Coventry
angles.copy: It's North London vs the Midlands as Arsenal host newly-promoted Coventry City this Friday to open the Premier League season. Big start for the Gunners!

moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Continues
moments.blurb: The world's largest arts festival, the Edinburgh Fringe, is in full swing until August 31st, drawing thousands of performers and visitors to Scotland's capital.

angles.name: Festival Vibe
angles.copy: Edinburgh is buzzing! The Fringe Festival is still going strong until August 31st. Have you caught any incredible shows yet?

angles.name: Scottish Focus
angles.copy: Scotland's capital is alive with the Edinburgh Fringe! So much talent on display until the end of the month. What's been your highlight?

moments.title: We Out Here Festival
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival, celebrating genre-hopping music and UK club culture, is happening this weekend, August 20th-23rd, in Wimborne St Giles, Dorset.

angles.name: Festival Kicks Off
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival kicks off tomorrow! Four days of incredible music and culture in Dorset. Who's heading down?

angles.name: Sold Out Vibes
angles.copy: It's a sold-out weekend for We Out Here Festival! Expecting big things from Gilles Peterson's celebration of UK club culture and beyond.

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Soon
moments.blurb: One of the UK's biggest rock and pop weekends, Reading & Leeds Festivals, is just around the corner, running from August 27th to 30th.

angles.name: Anticipation Build
angles.copy: The countdown is on! Reading & Leeds Festivals are just over a week away. Who's ready for an epic bank holiday weekend of music?

angles.name: Bank Holiday Plans
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds is calling! If you're heading to one of the biggest festivals of the summer, start planning your set times now – it's next weekend!

moments.title: Official Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold the top spot with "Rein Me In" on the Official Singles Chart Top 40, while Madonna & Kylie Minogue enter at number 8 with "Love Sensation."

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: New chart update! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still at #1. Can anyone knock them off next week?

angles.name: New Entry Buzz
angles.copy: A huge new entry from Madonna & Kylie Minogue with 'Love Sensation' straight in at number 8! Iconic collaboration!

moments.title: Summer Bank Holiday Approaches
moments.blurb: The final UK Bank Holiday of the summer for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is just days away, falling on Monday, August 31st.

angles.name: Holiday Plans
angles.copy: That glorious August Bank Holiday is nearly here! What are your plans for the last long weekend of summer?

angles.name: Local Reminders
angles.copy: Devon, get ready for a long weekend! The August Bank Holiday is Monday 31st. Perfect for exploring our beautiful county!

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the incredible voice of Deep Purple, Ian Gillan! What's your favourite track featuring his iconic vocals?
